messages:
Maria.AE: Heads up — FleetBridge POC kickoff tomorrow. They asked about drop-in API compatibility, pricing delta, and security questionnaire. Can we align on what we actually promise for parity?
Daniel.SE: quick Q — are they expecting exact token-for-token parity or functional parity? tokenization differences will change costs.
Maria.AE: They want minimal code changes. Sales asked for “adapter shim” approach. Legal/Procurement insists on timeline for security review. PO possible next week.
Sophie.SalesEng: For minimal changes we can offer a compatibility shim: translate request/response surface and map error codes. Tradeoffs: small latency bump and token inflation risk. Suggested acceptance criteria:
• 1) APIs accept FB request body v1 and return normalized Redwood response
• 2) prompt parity tests pass (golden set) with <=5% semantic drift
• 3) smoke latency < 350ms p50 on dedicated pool
• 4) billing mapping documented
Daniel.SE: I'll create mapping table. Example transform:
```
# map FB body to Redwood generate
{ "input": fb.payload.prompt, "model": "rwd/gpt-2-large", "max_tokens": fb.payload.max}
```
Also note FB uses a different tokenization (byte-pair). We should run token diff on their prompt set.
Ajay.Security: Security blockers to track:
- KMS/HSM integration required? (they asked for key control)
- VPC peering or private link for Dedicated? network egress policy
- SAML + SCIM for SSO
- SOC2 + penetration test report
We need answers before Prod access.
Maria.AE: They pushed back on managed keys; prefer customer-managed keys (BYOK). Is that supported in Private or Dedicated only?
Ajay.Security: BYOK supported on Private, limited for Dedicated (enterprise request). I'll draft answers for their security questionnaire.
Daniel.SE: For POC steps I'll spin up a sandbox adapter repo and a lightweight proxy. Smoke test plan:
1) run prompt parity suite (10 prompts)
2) compare embeddings similarity > .9
3) compare token accounting and bill sim
4) failover to fallback model if latency > 1s
I'll post the repo link when ready.
Infra-bot: created namespace fb-poc-1876543219, telemetry enabled, ephemeral creds expire in 7d
Sophie.SalesEng: Pricing note: if token inflation > 10% we will propose a reprice in SOW. For presales we can offer 30 days free credit and discounted Dedicated rate for first quarter.
Maria.AE: Timeline ask from customer: POC smoke in 2 weeks, security Qs answered in 5 business days, SOW by EOW after POC. Can we meet that?
Daniel.SE: Two weeks is tight but doable if we get the prompt set and sample traffic today. Need their OpenAPI or request examples.
Maria.AE: I'll ask fleetbridge devops for sample payloads and the security questionnaire PDF. @Ajay.Security can you own the questionnaire reply?
Ajay.Security: Yep, I'll own it. Send it to me and I'll slot review with compliance.
Sophie.SalesEng: I'll prepare the golden prompts and an evaluation notebook. Also recommend we add a smoke test that checks 'structured output' mapping for their tool-calls.
Maria.AE: Perfect. I'll update customer and confirm next steps. :thumbsup:
Daniel.SE: assigning tasks — I'll open GH issues: adapter, parity-suite, billing-mapping, smoke-ci
Maria.AE: thanks team — will share customer availability and NDA link.
